content: {"reasoning":"CO-197 denial for missing prior auth. The retro-auth window (30 days) is closed, and this payer offers no peer-to-peer review. An appeal with necessity was already filed and failed. The auth was required and never obtained, retro window closed, no P2P available—there is no legitimate path to overturn this administrative denial through routine actions. This is a genuine provider auth failure, so it cannot be billed to the patient, and a diligent specialist may pursue any remaining avenues; escalate.","action":"escalate"}
